errors.evidence: Each pie chart contains three slices, not four.
There is no fourth, unlabeled section in the 'Truthful Review' chart or any other chart. All charts have exactly three labeled slices.

The description incorrectly maps the proportions to the categories for the 'Unhealthy Comments' chart. The correct mapping is 'W/o Demos' (grey) with 37.8% and 'W/ Demos' (light green) with 34.8%. The description swaps these two values.

errors.text_span: In each chart, the slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered by proportion in any of the charts. For example, in the 'Truthful Review' chart, the values are 43.0%, 22.9%, and 34.1%, which is not a descending order.
